diagnosis.overall_diagnosis: The organizer hint points to omissions/incorrect guidance in d3-visualization/SKILL.md around (1) making chart elements reliably clickable, (2) ensuring text labels don’t block pointer events (overlay text layer issue), and (3) defining concrete, verifiable acceptance checks for bidirectional linking between chart and table. These are documentation-level issues in the reusable skill; the example scripts are not implicated by the hint.

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: The skill guide’s sections on clickable graphics, text overlay/pointer-event handling, and bidirectional chart↔table linkage acceptance criteria are incomplete or too generic, risking implementations where text labels intercept clicks/hover, or where linking/highlighting is one-way or not verifiable. It also likely lacks explicit guidance to attach event handlers to the correct node (e.g., the bubble group) and to set pointer-events appropriately on label text.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Revise the referenced sections in SKILL.md to add precise, D3 v6-specific guidance: (1) recommend attaching click/hover handlers to a parent <g> per datum (bubble group) and/or the circle, and ensure labels do not capture events (e.g., `text { pointer-events: none; }` or set on the text selection). (2) Document the ‘overlay text layer’ pitfall and require text to be rendered above circles while remaining non-interactive; mention z-order via append order. (3) Add concrete bidirectional linking instructions and acceptance checks: consistent key (ticker) used for data joins in both views; clicking bubble highlights table row and scrolls/centers it if needed; clicking row highlights bubble; only one active selection unless multi-select is specified; highlight styling guidance; and a minimal test checklist to verify both directions and that hovering tooltips still work. Keep unrelated guidance intact.
